headline: Peso may slide to 66:$1 in 2027–UBS
summary: UBS expects the Philippine peso could weaken to 66 per dollar by the end of 2027. It said the central bank could deliver two more quarter-point rate increases before cutting from 2028.
why: UBS Group is a Swiss global bank whose research is widely followed by investors. The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippines' policy rate, which drives the peso.

impacts.name: Philippine peso
impacts.why: UBS forecasts the peso could weaken to 66 per dollar by end-2027, based on expected central bank action.
